properties.displayName: AI — Hallucination Detection — Fabricated Entity References
properties.description: Detects LLM responses containing fabricated URLs, citations, or entity references indicating hallucination
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "hallucination" or Message contains "fabricated" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-HAL-001
